Mechanical components are noted with specific mechanical symbols, not detail markers. Incorrect. Special ordering notes are annotations or schedules, not detail markers. Detail markers are references to enlarged detail drawings. A detail marker on a plan or elevation (e.g., ⊙ 3) corresponds to a detail drawing labeled 'Detail 3', typically drawn at 1:20 or 1:10 scale to show construction assembly, material connections, and detailing that cannot be clearly shown at the overall drawing scale. When you see a detail marker on a drawing, locate the corresponding detail drawing to understand the construction assembly at that location. Details are essential for contractors to understand exactly how materials connect and are assembled.
